title.narrative: Consolidamento del Milan Urban Food Policy Pact (MUFPP)
Strengthening the Milan Urban Food Policy Pact (MUFPP)

description.narrative: 1) Rafforzamento del Segretariato MUFPP 2) Sviluppo di nuove competenze e strumenti per lo sviluppo di food policy nelle città firmatarie e promozione dell'MUFPP in nuove città ritenute reciprocamente prioritarie 3) Consolidamento dei temi del MUFPP nel dibattito nazionale e internazionale

La presente azione intende potenziare il Milan Urban Food Policy Pact (MUFPP), la rete di città sviluppata dal Comune di Milano come eredità di Expo 2015, nella sua azione di supporto alle politiche di governo delle 280 città firmatarie, nonché aprire ad ulteriori realtà urbane dei Paesi di intervento dell’Agenzia Italiana per la Cooperazione allo Sviluppo, per lo sviluppo di politiche alimentari urbane in grado di sviluppare sistemi alimentari sostenibili, inclusivi, resilienti, sicuri e diversificati, di garantire cibo sano e accessibile a tutti, di ridurre gli scarti alimentari e preservare la biodiversità, di mitigare e adattarsi agli effetti dei cambiamenti climatici. Il Patto prevede 37 azioni raccomandate (con 44 indicatori) raggruppate in 6 categorie d’azione: Governance, Diete sane e sostenibili, Equità sociale ed economica, Produzione alimentare, Distribuzione alimentare, Sprechi alimentari. L’iniziativa mira a rafforzare il Segretariato del MUFPP e la sua capacità di animazione delle città firmatarie, a rafforzamento le relazioni istituzionali con attori della cooperazione allo sviluppo e del Sistema Italia, a potenziare il MUFPP tra le città rilevanti per AICS, e a diffondere le food policy nel dibattito italiano e internazionale sulla cooperazione allo sviluppo.
Rafforzare il MUFPP nella sua azione di promozione delle Food Policy per le città presenti nei Paesi di cooperazione AICS

This action intends to strengthen the Milan Urban Food Policy Pact (MUFPP), the network of cities developed by the City of Milan as the main heritage of Expo 2015. The objective of the action is supporting the development of urban food policies among the 280 signatory cities as well as further strengthening the presence of the Pact in partner countries of the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS) by developing urban food policies that can boost sustainable food systems that are inclusive, resilient, safe and diverse, providing healthy and affordable food to all people, minimising waste and conserving biodiversity while adapting to and mitigating impacts of climate change. The Pact provides 37 recommended actions along (with 44 indicators) clustered in 6 categories: Governance, Sustainable Diets & Nutrition, Social & Economic Equity, Food Production, Food Supply & Distribution, Food Waste. The initiative aims at strengthening the MUFPP, both in its internal capacity, providing human resources to its Secretariat, thus contributing to animating the network, and in its institutional relations, through the engagement of development cooperation actors and key drivers of the “Italian system”. Furthermore, the action seeks to reinforce the role of the MUFPP in cities relevant both for AICS and for the network as well as disseminating food policies in the Italian and international debate on development cooperation.

tag.narrative: By 2030, double the agricultural productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers, in particular women, indigenous peoples, family farmers, pastoralists and fishers, including through secure and equal access to land, other productive resources and inputs, knowledge, financial services, markets and opportunities for value addition and non-farm employment

By 2030, end all forms of malnutrition, including achieving, by 2025, the internationally agreed targets on stunting and wasting in children under 5 years of age, and address the nutritional needs of adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women and older persons
By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round
By 2030, enhance inclusive and sustainable urbanization and capacity for participatory, integrated and sustainable human settlement planning and management in all countries

By 2030, ensure sustainable food production systems and implement resilient agricultural practices that increase productivity and production, that help maintain ecosystems, that strengthen capacity for adaptation to climate change, extreme weather, drought, flooding and other disasters and that progressively improve land and soil quality
By 2030, halve per capita global food waste at the retail and consumer levels and reduce food losses along production and supply chains, including post-harvest losses
Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions at all levels
Encourage and promote effective public, public-private and civil society partnerships, building on the experience and resourcing strategies of partnerships
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture

Enhance international support for implementing effective and targeted capacity-building in developing countries to support national plans to implement all the Sustainable Development Goals, including through North-South, South-South and triangular cooperation
Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns
Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable
Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels
Promote public procurement practices that are sustainable, in accordance with national policies and priorities
Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development
